syntactic_simplification:
Mice are important in neuroscience research. They provide a flexible model for scientists. Researchers can control and study mice. This helps them learn about how the brain works.

Researchers have often used male mice in experiments. They have preferred male mice over female mice. One reason for this is that female mice have a hormone cycle. This hormone cycle can cause changes in behavior. These changes might affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification:
Mice are important in brain research. They provide an easy way for scientists to study. Researchers can manage and examine mice. This helps them learn about how the brain functions.

Researchers have often used male mice in tests. They have chosen male mice over female mice. One reason for this is that female mice have a hormone cycle. This cycle can cause changes in behavior. These changes might affect the outcome of the tests.
paraphrase_or_explanation:
Mice play a key role in studying the brain. They are a convenient option for scientists because they can easily be managed and observed. By studying mice, researchers gain insights into how the brain works.

In their experiments, scientists usually prefer to use male mice instead of female mice. One reason for this choice is because female mice go through a cycle related to hormones, which are chemical substances that regulate many body functions. This hormone cycle can cause differences in behavior, which might interfere with the results of the experiments.
prompt_used: You simplify complex texts by rewriting them in Plain English. Use clear, descriptive and explanatory language. Your simplification can be longer than the source text if making it longer makes it easier to comprehend.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text:
Mice play a key role in studying the brain. They are convenient for scientists because they can easily be managed and observed. By studying mice, researchers learn how the brain works.

Scientists usually prefer to use male mice in their experiments instead of female mice. One reason for this is that female mice go through a hormone cycle, which affects their behavior. These changes in behavior could interfere with the results of the experiments.
